BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: V
BRANCH: CHEMICAL ENGINEERING- PLASTICS AND POLYMER SESSION : MO/2019

SUBJECT : PC5001 POLYMER TECHNOLOGY-II

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Give the reaction mechanism and stoichiometry ratio of reactant for Resol and Novolac. [3]
 (b) What is the function of Hexa? [2]


Q2 (a) Give  the  reaction  mechanism  and  the  condition  form  preparation  of  epoxy  resin
epichlorohydrin and bis - phenol A
[3]
 (b) Write at least five advantages of epoxy resins over phenolics [2]


Q3 (a) Structurally how polyesters and polycarbonates are similar? Elaborate on a point wise
manner.
[2]
 (b) What is by far the most important starting material for the preparation of polycarbonate
of the bis-phenol A type?
[3]


Q4 (a) Why  polysulphones are  less  susceptible  to  oxidation?  What  other  properties  do
polysulphones exhibit?
[2]
 (b) What is the parameter, which gives polycarbonates high values of toughness and damping
capacity over a wide range of temperatures?
[3]


Q5 (a) How do you prepare Melamine formaldehyde resin from its reactants? [2]
 (b) On a structural from work basis, elucidate some of the similarities and some of the
differences between polyethylene and polyacetal.
[3]


Q6 (a) What structural attributes are to be considered to support outstanding oxidative stability
and resistance to ozone in case of polycarbonates?
[2]
 (b) Give the reaction mechanism for the formation of silicon resin from different types of
monomers
[3]

[2]
